summary: Jin Medical International, a Cayman-incorporated China-based orthopedic device maker, closed its previously announced VIE acquisition of Huaxia Qiying (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. on September 24, 2026, via VIE Control Master Acquisition Agreement dated September 8, 2026, with Erhua Med obtaining contractual control and economic benefits. Aggregate purchase price was US$159,415,729, mixing share and non-share consideration. The company issued 71,282,488 Class A ordinary shares as share consideration plus 8,479,560 Class A shares to Veltrion Haskel Holdings as advisory compensation, without registration. Watch the uncompleted Kangma Equity transfer, replacing 622,123 shares if unresolved by October 31, 2026.
